verdict.rationale: The pack shows Pinecone has an API reference section (an Inference API introduction page under /reference/api), but nothing shows that reference is interactive or has runnable examples such as a try-it console or executable snippets. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, so there is also no indirect sign of a spec-driven interactive explorer. An API docs page alone is adjacent to this story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
